observed_defect.summary: The canonical Kata StatefulSet template used hostNetwork:false but no Kubernetes NetworkPolicy, while the MicroVM contract required controlled ingress/egress. Kubernetes pods are otherwise non-isolated by default for ingress and egress.
observed_defect.product_impact: A final Kubernetes/Kata deployment could satisfy the guest-kernel/runtime-class source shape while still inheriting broad cluster-network reachability unless the CNI happened to add restrictions outside the product contract.

portable DNS-only egress exception scoped to kube-system/k8s-app=kube-dns
provider Clerk/Claude/GLM egress remains fail-closed until separately admitted by endpoint-specific CNI/egress-gateway/proxy policy
contract_fences: cluster network plugin must actually enforce networking.k8s.io/v1 NetworkPolicy

primary_external_evidence: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy documentation: pods are non-isolated by default; a selecting policy with Ingress/Egress isolates those directions and empty rule lists deny traffic.
Kubernetes NetworkPolicy API: policyTypes controls isolation direction and empty ingress/egress rule sets allow no traffic for the selected direction.
